claim_or_scope: Declared corpus W: the complete frozen official instrument (Regulation (EU) 2023/956, original act as published, not consolidated): title, six citations, 82 recitals, 36 articles in 11 chapters, final formulas and six annexes, decomposed into 558 addressable units, every one inventoried and screened.
search_description: Every unit was read in source order; the parse was compared with the neutral metadata counts (36 articles, 6 annexes); internal cross-references were followed within W (GAP-03). 'Not found' statements refer to W only.

claim_or_scope: References to sources outside W: every reference found in operative provisions, annexes and formal citations is recorded as an EXT record; none was retrieved (GAP-04); recitals create no EXT.
search_description: Every unit was searched for references to other instruments, standards, administrative acts and national law; all EXT have source_verification_status not_checked and boundary_status outside_corpus_not_expanded.

claim_or_scope: No relation of ACCOUNTABILITY class (identifiable actor-forum relation with duty to explain, questioning capacity, assessment capacity and a grounded possibility of consequences) is coded in W; reporting and reasoned-decision relations are INFO, and appeal relations are indeterminate for lack of an identified forum.
search_description: Every coded relation was classified under RGAM-DR-17; the text of W was searched for forums, appeal bodies and consequences attached to the reasoned decisions and reports. 'Not found' is a statement about the search, not about the law; appeals and judicial review are governed outside W.

claim_or_scope: The status of authorised CBAM declarant is a necessary stage for importing goods within the scope of the Regulation, i.e. no alternative path to lawful importation exists.
search_description: A4, A25(1), A5, A17 and the derogations of A2(3), A2(4), A2(7) and A5(4) were examined; the scope derogations depend on thresholds and definitions in external instruments (Regulation (EC) No 1186/2009, Delegated Regulation (EU) 2015/2446, Regulation (EU) No 952/2013).

claim_or_scope: The indirect customs representative is a substitute for the importer as applicant for authorisation (A5(1)-(2)) and as reporter (A32), and no other substitute is provided.
search_description: A5, A32 and A35 were examined for alternative applicants and reporters; the status and powers of the indirect customs representative are constituted by an external Regulation.

claim_or_scope: No rule-making or standard-setting power is conferred on private actors (self-regulatory autonomy) by the text of W.
search_description: Every NA and QR with a rule_making_standard_setting function was reviewed for its holder; all holders are the Commission, the European Parliament, the Council or Member State bodies; verifiers apply rules set elsewhere (Annex VI). The statement concerns the text of W.

claim_or_scope: No qualified relation in W couples the transitional reporting regime (Articles 32-35) to the definitive-period regime (Articles 4-9, 14-26, 31) other than the temporal succession fixed by A32 and A36(2).
search_description: Cross-references from Articles 32-35 to Articles 4-31 were searched: A35(2)(b) and A35(7)(d) refer to Annex IV; A33-A35 refer to each other and to A32; none refers to Articles 5-26; the absence of an edge is not a proof of separation.
